name: agent-contract-test
description: Deterministic contract tests for AI coding agents.

scripts.lint: node --check src/cli.js && node --check src/contract.js && node --check src/verify.js && node --check src/runner.js && node --check src/adapters.js && node --check src/sarif.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm test && node src/cli.js validate examples/basic/agent-contract.json && node src/cli.js run examples/basic/agent-contract.json --root examples/basic/fixture --command "node agent.js" --allow-exec
scripts.demo: node src/cli.js run examples/basic/agent-contract.json --root examples/basic/fixture --command "node agent.js" --allow-exec --keep-workspace
